snippet.title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Magical Library DLC - Release trailer
snippet.description:
Available Now! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4734690/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions__Magical_Library_DLC/

The Magical Library expansion invites you into an arcane sanctuary overflowing with magical books, enchanted artifacts, and new Spirits to discover. 

Master the basics of magic by studying dusty grimoires in the grand archives, or spend quiet moments bonding with your Spirit companion, curled up among piles of books.

Join our cozy community!
